text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm out shopping with Taiki Shuttle on a
day off,
when...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What should I do? This whole trip is going to be a waste if I don't—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Flower! You sure look anxious
about
something.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing serious. I just can't
decide which
clothes to buy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heck! If that's all it is, I'll help ya out.
Fashion's
way more fun with a friend to
shake up your
style! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: To shake up... my style?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Yes, please! I'd love it if you'd join
me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow! These diamond shoes are absolutely gorgeous! Just look at 'em sparkle! You gotta try these on!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Diamonds?! On me?! I... I...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaah! ☆ Tell me this ain't the
coolest wetsuit
ya ever seen! It'd be
perfect for a rainy day! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! You mean you'd wear
something like
this out on the street?!
Talk about a bold fashion
statement!
Too bold for me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, leeet's see! ♪ What should we try
next? ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant... You've got so much energy...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No! Actually, I'm feeling really inspired!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The reason I wanted to go shopping
today is...
Well, it's because I wanted to
find clothes that
would make me look
more grown-up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But once I started looking at outfits, it
felt like
nothing really suited me, and I
felt too shy to try
anything on...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's why Taiki is so amazing! It's like
she can
pull off any look.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, honey, you've got it all wrong! It
doesn't take
skill to rock an outfit...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It takes heart!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's what I said! Take this outfit for
example—it
just shouts "active!" and
"cheerful!" It's all about
matchin' the
occasion! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What's yer heart tellin' ya, Flower? What
kinda
outfit and mood are ya aimin' for?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What kind of mood... Hm...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want something... kind... that brings a
smile to
everyone's face. I want to be
like a blooming
cosmos flower!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Bam! Now yer talkin'! Hold onto that
feelin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If that's the kinda outfit you want, then
that's the
outfit you should get! I'm
certain it'll look like it
was made just for
you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Okay! Then... I'm gonna go look
through the
shops one more time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle and I sit back and watch as
a smiling
Nishino Flower runs off to find
her new outfit.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Darn right she does! It'd be a crying
shame if she
wasn't, seeing as she's out
shopping! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Which reminds me... A certain somebody
hasn't
picked out a single thing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! I was hopin' you'd be on board! ☆ Now hurry up and spill the beans on what's in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What was your mood comin' out with me
today?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just like me?! You mean your heart and
mine
are... In other words...
choice_data_list: 君と同じく、楽しみだった
貴方と同じく、楽しみだった

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You wanna get matchin' outfits?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's get a top with super frilly
sleeves!
And do you remember those
pants with all the
hearts?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We need to get to the fitting room, like,
right
now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having misunderstood my intentions, she
runs off
to buy an outfit. This throws me
into a panic, and
I give chase!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I hear ya loud 'n' clear. No worries. I'll
foot the bill
today!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. It appears that your card is
maxed out...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You're kidding!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Looks like we're both poor as church mice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What're you sorry for? I'm about as
happy as a
pig in mud right now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We might not have matchin' outfits, but
we sure
as all get-out have matchin'
hearts! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, we head back to the
academy,
cheerfully chatting about the
day we had.
